semiconductor_relevance: High — TDK specializes in high-performance load ports and related technologies that are integral to semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: TDK develops and exhibits high-performance load ports that enhance the automation of semiconductor manufacturing by integrating advanced mechatronics and cleanroom technologies. Their TAS300 load port facilitates the automatic handling of FOUPs, ensuring optimal conditions for semiconductor components.
capabilities: High-performance load ports for semiconductor manufacturing
FOUP handling systems with nitrogen purging options
PLP load ports for advanced packaging
